baseline_comparison.method:
Compare matched BVmethods device rows in native population coordinates.

Each row and its RHS are divided by that row's own diagonal. This removes
constant row scales, not state-dependent scaling derivatives or stabilization.
Contact potential rows/columns and the native circuit aliases are excluded.
The input state-match audit must be interpreted alongside these differences.

findings.issue: Frontend Fermi + OldSlotboom omits fermi_statistics_correction; C++ default false. Existing opt-in control explains most zero-state QF/contact offset.
Poisson normalized charge coefficient at interface node129 is 2.026631 times native; material_local control changes ratio to0.888873 and does not fully align.
BVmethods density_gradient uses raw generalized Fermi SG edge flux, unlike SLOT old element density/QF-gradient source.
Native BVmethods per-element SG vectors, mobility, source support and full RHS remain unmatched; SLOT source-kernel qualification does not transfer.

limitations: Free psi/n/p matched; contact constitutive populations and derived QF/HFS/source inputs differ.
Native nonzero QF exports are post-update; debug matrices/populations are pre-update.
Circuit aliases and fixed contact psi rows/columns excluded; no full external-resistor certificate.
Row-normalized element differences do not identify an analytic derivative error or remove native stabilization.
No QS convergence or physical accuracy qualification from zero-update probes.
